description: This file defines custom formatters for various prach detection-related data structures within the ocudu namespace, including configuration, preamble indications, and detection results.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::prach_detector::configuration>
classes.description: Custom formatter for prach_detector configuration objects, formats various configuration parameters.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::prach_detection_result::preamble_indication>
classes.description: Custom formatter for preamble indication objects, formats index, time advance, detection metric, and power.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::prach_detection_result>
classes.description: Custom formatter for prach detection results, formats RSSI, resolution, max time advance, and preambles.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options from the context.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the respective data structure into the output context.
